purpose: Prevent accidental use of wrong/nearby branches, same-name superseded contracts, smoke-run outputs, historical datasets, or substitute scientific binaries in V64 execution.

canonical_authority.rule: A result claiming to execute the current frozen V64 statistical/Nott authority must descend from this commit or an explicitly adjudicated successor. Similar branch names are not authority.

frozen_statistical_decision_configuratio.rule: Only 18-donor/24-seed outputs may be called the decision-bearing V64 frozen red-team result. Smaller runs must be labelled SMOKE in filename, metadata and prose and cannot overwrite/carry authority.

verified_Claude_execution.changed_surface: one added runner, three added result JSONs, one added report; no canonical contract/V63 parent modification

forbidden_spillover_classes: same filename from a superseded branch
historical or exploratory output substituted for a frozen result
8-donor/3-seed or other smoke output described as the 18/24 decision run
Corces contact/accessibility substituted into the Nott construction lane
Morabito protected biological correspondence opened during Nott construction
NIH-CARD linked RNA-ATAC biological correspondence opened before E2 construction authority
AD loci or JEPA target genes used to rescue/tune Nott P1S
Kosoy/access-required artifact silently substituted for an authenticated open artifact
FILER-prelifted coordinates treated as equivalent to independent UCSC relift without the provenance audit
Nott neuronal/oligodendrocyte same-study comparators relabelled as independent P1 replication
coarse matching resurrected as the primary estimator
out-of-span observed nuisance function added to the estimator basis and called generalisation

raw cross-cell-type ATAC support-rate comparison used as the P1S primary gate after V2 supersession; primary must use within-track observed-minus-null excess support and microglia-vs-comparator difference-in-differences
fail_closed_rule: If an expected blob SHA, scientific binary SHA-256, parent commit, decision configuration, or declared dataset role does not match this allowlist or an explicit later successor, STOP and adjudicate provenance before computing/interpreting outcomes.
